tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Install (create) an Application in the caller's Organization from a Blueprint — the SAME action as the console's Install button. Reuses POST /api/v1/sovereigns/{id}/applications (the shared create seam), so the Org namespace is ensured and the Application CR is written by the catalyst-api exactly once. RBAC-scoped: an Org-scoped caller may create ONLY in their own Organization (a cross-Org organizationRef is forbidden); a sovereign-admin may create in any Organization. Requires tier-admin or higher (mirrors the console Install gate).

blueprint.description: Blueprint to install, e.g. bp-wordpress (must start with bp-).

environment.description: Target Environment ref, e.g. acme-prod. Optional — defaults to <organization>-prod.

name.description: Application name (metadata.name): RFC-1123 lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, 1-63 chars. Doubles as the app's purpose.

organization.description: Target Organization (slug or FQDN, e.g. acme or hw178.omani.works). OPTIONAL in Org context — defaults to the caller's own Org; a value naming a DIFFERENT Org is forbidden for an Org-scoped caller. REQUIRED for a sovereign-admin (no implicit Org).

parameters.description: Blueprint parameters (validated against the Blueprint's configSchema by the catalyst-api).

placement_mode.description: Topology mode: singleton (default), active-active, active-hot-standby, active-passive.

regions.description: Region IDs the instance targets. Optional — defaults to the Sovereign's primary region.

version.description: Blueprint version to pin, e.g. 1.2.3. Required by the catalyst-api install validator.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get a single Application by name in the caller's Organization (full status + spec the console detail view renders). Org-scoped: a name outside the caller's Org is not returned.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List the Applications in the caller's Organization, with blueprint, version, namespace, and phase — exactly what the console Applications page shows for that user. Thin facade over GET /api/v1/sovereigns/{id}/applications, Org-scoped.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List the Environments (env-type partitions: dev/staging/prod) visible to the caller, derived from the Applications running in the caller's Organization. Scoped to the caller's Org in Org context.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the Organizations the caller can see. In Org context this is the caller's own Organization only; a sovereign-admin sees every Organization on the Sovereign. Thin facade over GET /api/v1/organizations.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the resolved caller identity the MCP server sees: realm context (organization|sovereign), tier, Org scope, deployment, email. Mirrors the console's /auth/me.
